about: Brand videos (official videos linked to no release, kit or part) that stay off the home page's latest videos and the /videos/ feed: they show no RC car of the brand. Each pattern is a case-insensitive JavaScript regular expression on the video title; the first that matches names the reason. Videos of a release, kit or part always show. The importer already keeps aircraft, boats, static models and the brands' non-RC lines out of the data (hobbydex-tools tools/data/video_scope.toml); these are the brand videos that stay on the brand page but are no product news. tests/videoFeed.test.mjs holds examples.

exclude.reason: out of scope (aircraft, boats, slot cars, static models)
